arxiv-2011-12607.title: Isotopic and vibrational-level dependence of H 2 {}_{\text{{2}}} dissociation by electron impact
arxiv-2011-12607.creator: Liam H. Scarlett 1, Dmitry V. Fursa 1, Jack Knol 1, Mark C. Zammit 2, Igor Bray 1
arxiv-2011-12607.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Liam H. Scarlett 1, Dmitry V. Fursa 1, Jack Knol 1, Mark C. Zammit 2, Igor Bray 1. The low-energy electron-impact dissociation of molecular hydrogen has been a source of disagreement between various calculations and measurements for decades.

arxiv-2107-05881.title: A CCSD(T)-based permutationally invariant polynomial 4-body potential for water
arxiv-2107-05881.creator: Apurba Nandi, Chen Qu, Paul L. Houston, Riccardo Conte, Joel M. Bowman
arxiv-2107-05881.description: Abstract We report a permutationally invariant polynomial (PIP) potential energy surface for the water 4-body interaction. This 12-atom PES is a fit to 2119, symmetry-unique, CCSD(T)-F12a/haTZ (aug-cc-pVTZ basis for ‘O’ atom and cc-pVTZ basis for ‘H’ atom) 4-b interaction energies.

arxiv-2408-05137.title: Tensor Reduction for Feynman Integrals with Lorentz and Spinor Indices
arxiv-2408-05137.creator: Jae Goode, Franz Herzog, Anthony Kennedy, Sam Teale, and Jos Vermaseren
arxiv-2408-05137.description: Abstract We present an efficient graphical approach to construct projectors for the tensor reduction of multi-loop Feynman integrals with both Lorentz and spinor indices in D D dimensions. An ansatz for the projectors is constructed making use of its symmetry properties via an orbit partition formula. The graphical approach allows to identify and enumerate the orbits in each case.

arxiv-2410-22164.title: Raman Polarization Switching in CrSBr
arxiv-2410-22164.creator: Priyanka Mondal 1, Daria I. Markina 1, Lennard Hopf 1, Lukas Krelle 1, Sai Shradha 1, Julian Klein 2, Mikhail M. Glazov 3, Iann Gerber 4, Kevin Hagmann 1, Regine v. Klitzing 1, Kseniia Mosina 5, Zdenek Sofer 5, Bernhard Urbaszek 1
arxiv-2410-22164.description: Abstract Semiconducting CrSBr is a layered A-type antiferromagnet, with individual layers antiferromagnetically coupled along the stacking direction. Due to its unique orthorhombic crystal structure, CrSBr exhibits highly anisotropic mechanical and optoelectronic properties acting itself as a quasi-1D material. CrSBr demonstrates complex coupling phenomena involving phonons, excitons, magnons, and polaritons.

arxiv-2506-06162.title: Recommender systems, stigmergy, and the tyranny of popularity
arxiv-2506-06162.creator: Zackary Okun Dunivin, Paul Smaldino
arxiv-2506-06162.description: Abstract Scientific recommender systems, such as Google Scholar and Web of Science, are essential tools for discovery. Search algorithms that power work through stigmergy, a collective intelligence mechanism that surfaces useful paths through repeated engagement. While generally effective, this “rich-get-richer” dynamic results in a small number of high-profile papers that dominate visibility.

arxiv-2601-14015.title: BallotRank: A Condorcet Completion Method for Graphs
arxiv-2601-14015.creator: Jason Douglas Todd, Ismar Volić
arxiv-2601-14015.description: Abstract . We introduce BallotRank, a ranked preference aggregation method derived from a modified PageRank algorithm. It is a Condorcet-consistent method without damping, and empirical examination of nearly 2,000 ranked choice elections and over 20,000 internet polls confirms that BallotRank always identifies the Condorcet winner at conventional values of the damping parameter.

pmc-10680547.title: Хирургическое лечение феохромоцитом
pmc-10680547.creator: Ш. Ш. Шихмагомедов, Д. В. Реброва, Л. М. Краснов, Е. А. Фёдоров, И. К. Чинчук, Р. А. Черников, В. Ф. Русаков, И. В. Слепцов, Е. А. Згода
pmc-10680547.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Данная обзорная статья содержит в кратком изложении современные представления об аспектах предоперационной подготовки, хирургического лечения и последующего наблюдения больных с надпочечниковыми феохромоцитомами. Главной составляющей медикаментозной предоперационной подготовки является применение альфа-адреноблокаторов. Необходимость их назначения всем пациентам все чаще оспаривается, особенно для пациентов без выраженной артериальной гипертензии, и все большее число публикаций демонстрирует положительные результаты хирургического лечения без применения альфа-блокаторов, выступая за индивидуальный подход и их назначение только при наличии определенных показаний.

pmc-11499407.title: Lateral Compression Fragility Fractures of the Pelvis: Diagnosis, Classifications, and Modern Management
pmc-11499407.creator: Joseph T. Patterson, Joshua A. Parry
pmc-11499407.description: Purpose of ReviewTo describe the diagnosis, classification, and modern management of lateral compression fragility fractures of the pelvis.Recent FindingsPractice patterns are shifting toward early operative treatment of fragility fractures of the pelvis among patients who are unable to mobilize or whose injuries demonstrate occult instability on stress imaging.

pmc-12362959.title: The comparison of physicochemical and bioactivity properties of different nanoparticles modified calcium silicate-based cement
pmc-12362959.creator: Silsupa Saingern, Naruporn Monmaturapoj, Chanakarn Sinsareekul, Porawit Kamnoedboon, Thanaphum Osathanon, Murali Srinivasan, Pavena Chivatxaranukul, Thawanrat Singthong, Chalermkwan Makornpan, Dusit Nantanapiboon
pmc-12362959.description: BackgroundTo investigate the effects of adding ZrO₂, TiO₂, and two sizes of hydroxyapatite (HAP) nanoparticles on the physicochemical and bioactivity properties of calcium silicate-based cement (CSC).MethodsMTA, PC, and nanoparticle-modified groups (5% and 10% n-ZrO₂, n-TiO₂, n-HAP1, n-HAP2) were evaluated for setting time, compressive strength (1, 7, 14 days), solubility (14 days), and bioactivity.

pmc-12565659.title: The Mitochondrial Hsp90 Homolog PmTRAP1 Mediates Thermal Tolerance in the Papaya Mealybug, Paracoccus marginatus
pmc-12565659.creator: Yanting Chen, Xiaomin Zhao, Chenyu Lv, Jianwei Zhao, Mengzhu Shi, Jianwei Fu, Jianyu Li
pmc-12565659.description: Simple SummaryThe papaya mealybug, Paracoccus marginatus, is a major agricultural pest known for its high-temperature resilience. This study explores the molecular basis of thermal adaptation in this species by focusing on the role of heat shock protein 90 (Hsp90) genes. We cloned and characterized three Hsp90 genes—PmHsp90-1, PmHsp90-2, and PmTRAP1—and analyzed their expression under heat stress.

pmc-12640596.title: Effects of Functional Magnetic Stimulation Combined with Pelvic Floor Muscle Training on Cerebral Hemodynamics and Brain Functional Connectivity in Women with Postpartum Pelvic Floor Dysfunction: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12640596.creator: Siyan Cai, Xiaotong Zu, Xuyan Ren, Mingyue Xu, Chunya Xia, Huifang Tian, Yufei Zhu, Chunguang Li, Yueming Zhang, Min Su
pmc-12640596.description: BackgroundThe central and peripheral effects of pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) combined with functional magnetic stimulation (FMS) on postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) remain unknown. This study aimed to compare the efficacy of PFMT + FMS versus PFMT + sham FMS on postpartum PFD and to explore the underlying central nervous mechanisms.

pmc-13371002.title: Anger Rumination as a Moderator of the Association between Factor 2 of Psychopathy and Proactive Aggression
pmc-13371002.creator: Carolina Sarrate-Costa, Marisol Lila, Luis Moya-Albiol, Ángel Romero-Martínez
pmc-13371002.description: Objective: Scholars have identified psychopathic traits as facilitators of intimate partner violence (IPV). Analyzing anger management strategies might clarify how these personality traits contribute to violence proneness. One potential moderator to consider is the tendency to ruminate about anger (or anger rumination).

uslaw-usc-t15-s382.title: 15 U.S.C. § 382 — Assessment of net income taxes
uslaw-usc-t15-s382.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s382.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 10B (State Taxation Of Income From Interstate Commerce); Subchapter I (Net Income Taxes). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Limitations No State, or political subdivision thereof, shall have power to assess, after September 14, 1959, any net income tax which was imposed by such State or political subdivision, as the case may be.
